title: The dead keep the night
changes: By day most skeletons lie in the earth: only a work gang stays up in the quarry, ruins, barrows, Gravemoor and Greywatch Keep.
At nightfall the dead climb out of their graves and their camps fill up. At dawn they sink back into the ground.
Necromancers, Bone Demons, the Pale Marshal and the Hollow King only walk at night, and the bone rituals only happen under the night sky.
The skeleton quests now tell you when to come back after dark, and the quest tracker shows how long until the dead rise.
